facades.name: GuardProposedOrdinaryStockUse
facades.transactionBoundary: Stock consumer UoW owns effect; QAP guard is a same-UoW participant

mechanismRules.proofRead: Every accepted-QAP body is paired with its immutable Evidence ref; Body JCS SHA-256 equals ref.digest.
mechanismRules.familyContinuity: Directory and every member head are read under the declared lock cut and rechecked in the committing UoW.
mechanismRules.finalGuardUse: Allowed guard and QapUseFact commit with the business effect; BLOCKED/UNKNOWN persist no effect/use row.
mechanismRules.observationXor: Exactly one of numeric value or enumerated code is present.
mechanismRules.payload: payloadBodyJcs validates against exactly the schema selected by PayloadType and hashes to payloadDigest.
mechanismRules.replay: C01 returns the stored request and terminal response bytes, not a regenerated label or latest state.
mechanismRules.currentSource: Exact source and output bytes plus current head and current ResultSet coverage are separate, non-substitutable identities.
mechanismRules.requiredFenced: UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN/NOT_AUTHORIZED never infer absence; REAL proposed adapters reject OWNER_PROTOCOL_NOT_READY.

sourceDigestContinuity.rule: Owner original digest equals source ref, head, mapping, payload and delivery source digest

stockSeparation.rule: I18 is Quality approval only; ordinary Stock use is F15 and persists its own consumer result/effect

fixtureModel.branchRegistryRule: each actual step records its exact branch writes; writes must be a declared subset and every required scenario write is separately gated
